title: Compatible residue fields from a coproduct presentation of a stalk base change
statement: Let f:X -> N be any scheme morphism, s a point of N, I a small index type, and S_i commutative rings with algebras over the actual stalk R = O_(N,s). Suppose an isomorphism c from X times_N Spec R to the coproduct of Spec S_i is given and commutes with the structural maps induced by the R-algebras. For any x in X with f(x)=s there exist i and a prime q of S_i, a ring equivalence e:kappa_N(f(x)) -> kappa(q contracted to R), and a ring equivalence g:kappa_X(x) -> kappa(q), such that the canonical residue-field algebra maps commute with e and g. No domain, finiteness, torsor, Cartier, or group hypotheses are required. The geometric presentation over Spec R is required.

source.place: Residue comparison in step 3 of lem-sbc-cartier-generic-stalk-galois-model-core; localization background Tag 0307; Mathlib Stalk, PullbackCarrier, ResidueField and LocalRing.ResidueField.Ideal

proof.text: A morphism surjective on stalks gives a surjective residue-field map by lifting first through the residue quotient and then through the stalk map. A field homomorphism is injective, so this map is bijective. For a Spec algebra map, prove residueFieldIso naturality by precomposing with its inverse, applying Ideal.ResidueField.ringHom_ext and checking on base ring elements using evaluation naturality, GammaSpecIso inverse naturality and scalar towers.

Lift x and the closed point of Spec R to the pullback by Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback. Apply sigmaOpenCover.exists_eq to c.hom of that lift, yielding i and a point y of Spec S_i. Compose its coproduct inclusion with c.inv and the pullback first projection to obtain d:Spec S_i -> X. This sends y to x. The supplied structural equality implies d followed by f equals Spec(algebraMap R S_i) followed by N.fromSpecStalk s.

Take q=y.asIdeal. Both N.fromSpecStalk s and d are preimmersions: the latter is a coproduct open immersion followed by an isomorphism and a base change of the stalk preimmersion. The residue maps of both are therefore bijective. Compose their ring equivalences with Spec.residueFieldIso and the necessary residueFieldCongr to construct e and g. Affine residue naturality and residueFieldMap_comp, with Hom.residueFieldMap_congr of the structural equality, give the desired square. This is a complete Lean proof, using no sorry.

lean.statement:
theorem stalk_product_residue_comparison
    {N X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ N) (s : N)
    (I : Type) (S : I → CommRingCat.{u})
    (alg : ∀ i, Algebra (N.presheaf.stalk s) (S i)) :
    letI := alg
    ∀ (c : pullback f (N.fromSpecStalk s) ≅ ∐ fun i : I ↦ Spec (S i)),
      c.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i : I ↦
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (N.presheaf.stalk s) (S i)))) =
          pullback.snd f (N.fromSpecStalk s) →
      ∀ (x : X), f x = s →
        ∃ (i : I) (q : Ideal (S i)) (hq : q.IsPrime),
          letI := hq
          letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver
            (q.under (N.presheaf.stalk s)) q
          letI := (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
          ∃ (e : N.residueField (f x) ≃+*
              (q.under (N.presheaf.stalk s)).ResidueField)
            (g : X.residueField x ≃+* q.ResidueField),
            (algebraMap (q.under (N.presheaf.stalk s)).ResidueField
              q.ResidueField).comp e.toRingHom =
              g.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap (N.residueField (f x))
                (X.residueField x))
